scientific_integrity: Every finite poset, every finite field, and every integer tuple length at least two are proved from explicit simultaneous conjugation and exact orbit-stabilizer counting. Exhaustive field-convolution checks were performed on stated small posets and prime fields; these checks alone are not the infinite proof. Published equivalent results outside checked sources remain a possible priority risk. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only ordered tuples of pairwise commuting idempotents in incidence algebras of finite posets over finite fields are counted. Arbitrary commuting elements, partial commutativity, and conjugacy by all algebra automorphisms are not classified. Full combinatorial evaluation can be exponential in poset size.
title: Commuting idempotent tuples of incidence algebras as a Potts partition function
